briefs.brief: A rounded badge with a short label that chases a keyframed target point (Target X, Target Y) on a spring with visible overshoot, tilting into its velocity. Props: target point, stiffness, damping, label text, badge color, text color, badge size.

A classic arrow cursor with a fading comet trail: the last second of its path sampled from history(), drawn as shrinking dots. It squashes along its heading when it brakes hard. Props: target point, trail length, stiffness, damping, cursor size, cursor color.

Slow aurora bands drifting across the frame in one WebGL2 shader pass: layered sine-warped gradients in two keyframable colors over a dark sky, with a hint of Bayer grain so gradients never band. Props: flow speed, band scale, warp, hue shift, two colors.

A VHS tracking effect as a generated pattern in one WebGL2 pass: horizontal scanlines, a rolling tracking band with wobble, chromatic offset, and noise whose amount is keyframable. Props: noise amount, band position, band height, aberration, scanline strength, tint.

A three.js scene: three glowing torus rings orbiting a bright core at different tilts and speeds, on transparency. Everything is a pure function of t (rotation = speed * t). Mirror the frame inputs on the canvas as data-frame JSON. Props: orbit speed, ring tilt, core color, ring color, glow.

A three.js scene: a tumbling icosahedron lit by two colored lights, on transparency, spinning at a keyframable rate around a tilted axis. Pure function of t. Mirror the frame inputs on the canvas as data-frame JSON. Props: spin speed, tilt, body color, wireframe on/off.

A small robot avatar (open-bot-avatar, time-pure renderAvatarSvg) that looks at a keyframed gaze point and cycles idle/thinking/happy with time. Big and centered for a lower corner. Props: gaze X, gaze Y, body color, eye color, avatar size, mood speed.

Kinetic type: each letter of a short word hangs from its own point on a verlet rope and swings when a keyframed anchor point moves. Props: anchor X, anchor Y, word, rope length, gravity, letter size, text color.
A classic lower-third title card: a name and a role slide in from the left with an overshooting ease, over a thin accent bar. Props: name, role, accent color, text color, bar height, entrance speed.
A circular countdown: a ring drains over the duration while a big number counts the seconds left, then flashes Done. Props: total seconds, ring color, number color, ring thickness, label.

note: No transition briefs: a transition needs two footage inputs and an OGraf title receives none, so every brief is a generator, overlay, or rig. Pass per brief: bundles, deterministic, at least one Inspector prop.
